text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
"Summer training camp starts tomorrow, huh.
Things will get busy, so I won't be able to
help out for a while..."

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, please don't worry.
Some volunteers said they'd help us out♪

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
"Once they learned how great the hot springs were,
many students and Trainers raised their hands to help."

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, everyone at the hot spring town is fired up saying
'We want to bathe in a new hot spring!'
They said they'll lend us a hand!

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Everyone around here
is really grateful to you guys, too.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu♪
I'm sure every inn and shop can feel the town's excitement firsthand.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "I'm gonna keep investigating the secret hot spring legends too, so feel free to hit me up whenever if anything happens~."

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I'll try asking around here as well.
Let's both do our best.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looks like there's no need to worry about the hot springs resort.
Now, let's focus on the summer training camp――!
